title: Cancer recurrent hotspots track pack (per-source gate required)
context: Recurrent cancer mutation hotspot resources (e.g. MSKCC cancer hotspots at cancerhotspots.org) identify positions mutated in statistically significant fractions of tumours. These are Priority-B sources whose redistribution terms must be verified before any track is built. This source-catalog task is related to the M2 pack-015 task; the catalog-014 triage determines which hotspot source is APPROVED before either pack task proceeds. If terms cannot be confirmed as permitting redistribution, the source stays EXCLUDE.
objective: Verify redistribution rights for a specific cancer hotspot source through catalog-014, run the licensegate-002 gate, and if APPROVED, deliver the hotspot track pack on hg38+hg19 (see also pack-015).
acceptanceCriteria: A specific hotspot source is confirmed APPROVED in catalog-014 with cited redistribution terms and permitsRedistribution: true (or marked EXCLUDED if terms cannot be confirmed).
licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 PASS artifacts committed; re-identification check PASS recorded (hotspots are aggregate position statistics).
If gate FAILS, task is EXCLUDED with the reason documented and no track is built.

If gate PASSES: all three browser targets emitted and render-verified; per-feature provenance records source record IDs, release version, and license; provenance completeness ≥ 90/100; not-medical-advice notice present.
output: output/packs/cancer-hotspots-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-hotspots-012.json (or EXCLUDED record if gate fails).
